name: verify-email-banner
title: Verify email banner
description: A banner for unverified accounts that names the address, resends the email with a cooldown that survives a reload, and lets people fix a typo.
docs: email is the address to verify and reason finishes the sentence ("to start sending invites"). onResend returns a promise: a rejection shows its message under the buttons and does not start the wait. After a send the button counts down for cooldownSeconds (60), worked out from timestamps and kept in sessionStorage under storageKey, so a reload does not reset it; the countdown is spoken at its start and its end only, while the button's own name is what it shows ("Resend in 28s"), so voice control can reach it. onChangeEmail(address) turns the address into a field: return an error message to show under it, or nothing, and the new address gets its own email and its own wait. When verified turns true the banner swaps to a short Email verified and folds away; if it is true on first render nothing is drawn. labels carries every word.
